description.text: Master Deck Build Box EX (100+40 cards chosen by top players), released on 14 September 2012. Its 140 cards of 51 kinds are all non-holo reprints of cards from earlier Black & White products: 100 cards often found in the decks of high-placing tournament players, such as Mewtwo-EX, Darkrai-EX and Rayquaza-EX with must-have Trainer and Special Energy cards, and 40 basic Energy, eight of each of five types. It came in a long card box with three dividers and a book on building top players' decks. Two boxes held enough for a serious 60-card deck.
